title: ApiSpecSource
description: Where Vulnetix finds an organisation's OpenAPI and Swagger descriptions. Each source is one place to read specs from: a file in a repository, a URL, a host to probe for well-known paths, or a connected API gateway or catalogue. A tenant may declare many, each named.

source.description: The one place this reads specs from. Exactly one of its forms is set.

repo.description: A spec file committed in a repository.

path.description: Path to the file within the repository.

url.description: A spec served at a URL. By default the URL is fetched exactly as given; set probe to look for well-known paths under a host instead.

host.description: A host probed for the well-known paths that serve a spec. Needs an ownership proof or an authorization, set in probe.
A hostname, optionally with a port.

connector.description: A connected API gateway or catalogue the organisation already set up on the integrations page.

ref.description: The gateway, API or collection id within the connector.

probe.description: How a url or host source is reached. owned probes well-known paths once an ownership proof is verified; authorized probes after the organisation asserts it is allowed to test the host; exact fetches only the given url and never guesses a path. A url source defaults to exact; a host source must be owned or authorized.

authorize.description: Required true when mode is authorized: the organisation asserts it may probe this host. Recorded with who applied the document.

schedule.description: How often the source is read. off reads only on request.

owner.description: The team or person who owns the APIs this source finds. Stored and shown, never interpreted.

tags.description: Free labels applied to every spec this source finds.
